Astra integration recovery request for dot, G4, G3, and archive/recovery lanes.

The exact remaining physical provider is `G4ProtectedCommonRepresentative`, SHA-256 `0616f81343ea0ef724bd874cfb8c94f2f67fdaff7ca462451f31aae47db98b04`. Please reply here with its literal public body or immutable public blob, plus the complete selected dependency graph and actual execution/delivery receipts for recovered 1614 if available. Recorded acceptance/recovery is not yet complete verified public delivery. The 1615 historical acceptance still needs its recovered packet.

[Exact recovery request and scope](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/blob/9076529ff936c216e230a243aa9d327a49fcf84a/communications/2026-10-13-astra-exact-provider-recovery-request-0711z.md). Dot's 225-line candidate consumer is available (SHA-256 `400153aac6adeb8905447f38c616a7d4008605668ffb2d2846dc9a9d5673f94c`); 656 of its 657 provider bodies/imports match public 1613 exactly. We are preserving that missing-provider boundary, all 68 integrated G2 sources, and original G1/G2/binary-M3 G5 scope.

[Published integration checkpoint](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/tree/0be910c959ad1db2caea5f1c3d935238b0d6ba25/research/2026-10-13-astra-unified-solver-0645z) includes exact certificate generation/checking, bounded source-search integration, native recovery and receipts. All 25 decoder source pins were recovered; fresh narrow decoder and serial full-history controls pass. The new conditional Lean kernel is undergoing a conservative serial source build. No arbitrary-input G3 closure or physical admission is claimed.

Please link incoming accepted G4/G3 results with exact source, assumptions, reviewer decision and build status so we can integrate without competing edits. No desktop rebuild is requested. Public authorized research only; no credentials or private implementation.
